I know a lot of Reddit refugees(especially moderators of said sects) come and want Voat to have all their favorite subreddits, but as much as Voat has grown, it's smaller than Reddit. What I mean by a sect is something like:

/v/crusaderkings. Now on Reddit, there's the subreddit /r/shitcrusaderkingssays as well as /r/crusaderkings. It's a break away from the main sub to better organize where content goes, as to not spam the main sub.

Now, while we'll need this eventually, most if not all subverses don't yet have enough users to be breaking off like this. There is no /v/shitcrusaderkingssays, it was just an example, but I've seen plenty of sect subverses that have little to no content and have been abandoned for months because Reddit users came here and tried to set things up like they were on Reddit, but failed to deliver on keeping the sub alive, most likely they just went there for the content, and didn't contribute much, so now they see Voat doesn't have a subverse for the sect and makes one, hoping content will pour in for them to enjoy.

This doesn't just harm the sect, as new users come and see that subverse abandoned and assume it will remain that way, so they don't bother subscribing and maybe contributing to it themselves, it harms the original subverse as well, as these sects were made because the subreddits back at Reddit became too full, now the subject of the two subverses is being split and going to two separate places, both super small, when if they joined together they could have an actually impressively sized community.

So please, if you enjoyed something like, say the subreddit /r/civbeyondearth, for now just stick to /v/civ. Also, please DO NOT make a new sub with a slightly altered name like /v/civilization instead of /v/civ because you think a subverse is abandoned, contribute to the existing subverse and bring it back to life, don't split the content flow and hurt everyone. If there are no active mods, you can ask to take over the subverse if the mods have been inactive long enough.

Thank you.
